meta.name: Globe Land Intelligence — Master Feature List
meta.purpose: The single machine-readable source of truth for the Globe build backlog, from the current prototype (V1) to the autonomous global land-intelligence network (V5). Pair with claude.md (engineering law) and the source docs below. Do not duplicate this enumeration elsewhere — reference feature ids.
howToUse: Pick the lowest-version, highest-priority feature whose dependsOn are all status=done.
Before writing code, resolve every id in `reuses` to its module in `reusableModules` and extend it — never re-implement.
A feature is done only when every item in `acceptance` is verifiably true and the global definitionOfDone passes.
When you build a new shared capability, register it in `reusableModules` and list it in the feature's `produces`.

status.prototype: Exists but only on mock/file data or with known gaps; must be hardened.
status.blocked: Cannot start until a dependency or Phase 0 fix lands.

priority.P0: Foundation / stabilization — required before real users.

version.V3: National intelligence platform + valuation engine + API.
version.V4: Global land operating system — 50+ countries, marketplace, risk suite.

dry.law: Build each capability exactly once, expose it from a shared module, and reuse it everywhere. Duplication is a defect.
rules: All domain enums, provenance, and DTOs live in @globe/types and are imported by api/web/admin. Re-declaring a DTO in an app is a build-blocking error (see audit: DTOs were re-declared in land-intelligence-app.tsx and admin/page.tsx — eliminate).
All geospatial math (coordinate normalization, H3, distance, bbox) lives in @globe/geo. No app computes geometry inline.
All cross-service constants and environment-schema validation live in @globe/config.
All shared React UI (chips, badges, legends, drawers, stat cards, provenance badge, charts) lives in @globe/ui with design tokens; apps compose, never re-style primitives.

HTTP concerns are table-driven: every endpoint is a RouteDefinition in api.router; never hand-roll request parsing, CORS, or security headers per handler — reuse writeJson / statusResolver / parse helpers.
Persistence goes through one durable store abstraction with an async write-queue. The three ad-hoc file stores (user/intake/review) collapse into it.
Legal display + provenance masking is one adapter (api.policy) applied centrally to every outbound object — no endpoint reads raw data arrays directly (see audit: exportMemo bypass).
Per-market behavior lives behind the market-adapter interface; market-specific code must never leak into the global core.
Freshness/confidence scoring is one engine consumed by API, tiles, valuation, and UI.

reusableModules.responsibility: PriceState, FreshnessTier, ConfidenceLabel, CoverageTier enums; ProvenanceStamp; PricePoint.
All API DTOs (Market, Parcel, Listing, Alert, User, SavedSearch, Compare, IntakeSubmission, CollectionResponse<T>, …). Single source of truth.
normalizeLongitude, isValidCoordinate, toGeoPoint.
H3 cell assignment, multi-resolution aggregation, distance, bbox, polygon ops.
PLATFORM_NAME, API_PREFIX, DEFAULT_MARKET_ROLLOUT_RULES.
Typed environment-variable schema + fail-fast validation in production.
Design tokens: spacing, type, color semantics (ask/closed/estimate/broker_verified/freshness/confidence/risk).
Shared components: chip, legend, stat card, drawer, filter group, ticker row, provenance badge, sparkline.
RouteDefinition table, resolveRoute, writeJson/writeNoContent, CORS + security headers, statusResolver pattern.
Typed body/query parse + validation helpers (need max-length + email-format guards).
Central legal-display/provenance masking for every outbound object.
Durable persistence abstraction with async serialized write-queue; Postgres-backed in prod.
HMAC session tokens, TTL, client-key rate limiting, role checks.
PostGIS canonical schema + migration workflow + seeds.
Reusable connector contract: pull → snapshot → checksum → parse → normalize → QA → publish; retries, lineage; 37-source registry.
One adapter interface (currency, units, tenure, zoning, freshness, legal rules); many market implementations.
Bronze (raw/) → silver (jsonl) → gold read model; lineage manifests, health state; Postgres canonical layer still pending (F-E4-01).
Load latest silver JSONL per source, map to Market/Parcel/Listing DTOs, merge with mock fixtures; env GLOBE_INGEST_DATA_DIR.
Freshness + confidence scoring engine with human-readable explanations.
Reconcile ask/closed/estimate/broker_verified; headline ranking; chart rules.
AVM feature pipeline, model registry, prediction intervals, batch + on-demand inference.
Full-text + geo-shape + vector search with typed grouped results.
Vector-tile generation/serving for H3 cells, boundaries, parcels, overlays; cache-safe versioning; render-safe fields only.
Event store + change-detection jobs + alert rule engine + anti-spam dedupe + delivery.
Structured logging, request logging, tracing, metrics — shared across apps/services.

feature: Code committed in the correct package/service (shared logic in a package, not an app).
All referenced `reuses` modules were extended, not duplicated.
Tests added; npm run test passes.
npm run lint and npm run typecheck pass.
Provenance + legal-display behavior handled for any user-facing datum.
Docs/fixtures updated; screenshots for UI; docs/documentation.md log updated.

epics.name: Phase 0 — Stabilize the prototype
epics.goal: Close every critical/major/minor issue from the audit (claude.md) before real users exist. These are blocking for V2.

features.title: Fix exportMemo legal-display bypass
features.description: exportMemo reads parcels.find() directly and returns un-redacted restricted parcels. Apply api.policy masking to every parcel and return 403 if any resolves to REDACTED.
acceptance: Restricted parcel (e.g. p-ldn-001) never returns canonicalParcelId/area/zoning via memo
403 returned when any requested parcel is policy-restricted

features.title: Replace SHA-256 password hashing with argon2id/scrypt
features.description: Swap general-purpose digest for a password-hashing function; detect legacy hashes on login and re-hash on success.
acceptance: New passwords stored with argon2id or node:crypto.scrypt (cost ≥ 12 equivalent)
legacy SHA-256 hashes transparently upgraded at next successful login
no plaintext or fast-digest path remains

features.title: Constant-time password comparison
features.description: Replace `attemptedHash !== user.passwordHash` with timingSafeEqual over equal-length buffers.
acceptance: no early-return on length mismatch that leaks timing

features.title: Durable stores — remove /tmp production default
features.description: User/intake/review stores default to ephemeral /tmp in prod, destroying all data on deploy. Require explicit store-file env in prod or back with Postgres.
acceptance: prod start fails fast if store path/DB unset
single store abstraction backs all three

features.title: Async serialized write-queue (no event-loop block, no corruption)
features.description: Replace synchronous writeFileSync on every mutation with an async single-promise-chain write queue serializing all writes.
acceptance: no synchronous fs writes in request path
two concurrent POSTs never lose a record

features.title: Require and validate critical env vars at startup
features.description: Require APP_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET in production (no operator-password or ephemeral-random fallback); validate APP_OPERATOR_* are not placeholders. Build a typed env schema module.
acceptance: prod start fails fast when APP_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET missing
no secret falls back to operator password or per-process random
env schema reused by api + services

features.title: Rate-limit and unify user login + registration
features.description: User-account login path bypasses the operator rate limiter, allowing unlimited brute force; registration is unthrottled. Apply a shared clientKey rate-limit map to both.
acceptance: repeated failed user logins return 429 after threshold
one shared limiter used by all auth paths

features.title: Respect APP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES for user tokens
features.description: User token TTL is hardcoded to 12h; use getSessionTtlMs() like the operator path.
acceptance: env var changes user token expiry

features.title: Input hardening — max-length, email format, compare cap, OPTIONS resolution
features.description: Add max-length guards to all free-text fields, a real email regex, a 20-id cap on compareParcels (400 on excess), and resolve routes before answering OPTIONS.
acceptance: OPTIONS on unknown path does not return 204

features.title: Frontend, CSP, and schema cleanups
features.description: Gate CSP connect-src localhost:4000 to dev; self-host MapLibre fonts; type EMPTY_GRID_FILTER; remove dead admin localStorage.removeItem; add 'closed' to listing.price_state CHECK (or document); remove sanitizeAlert no-op; stop emitting center 0,0 for masked parcels.
acceptance: prod CSP has no localhost connect-src
no demo tile/font endpoint in prod
masked parcels omit center rather than 0,0

epics.goal: Detect physical change on Earth's land continuously as a data and signal source.

features.title: Imagery ingestion + change diffing
features.description: Ingest commercial + open imagery (Planet/Maxar/Sentinel/Landsat) and build change-over-time diffs.
acceptance: imagery snapshots + diffs stored with provenance

features.title: Construction + land-use change detection (CV)
features.description: CV models detecting construction starts, land-use change, vacant land, and impervious surface; analyst-verified flags via active learning.

features.title: Encroachment + environmental monitoring
features.description: Detect illegal builds/encroachment, vegetation/agriculture change, and post-disaster damage; solar/renewable suitability.

epics.name: Infrastructure Intelligence
epics.goal: Price the future: track infrastructure pipelines and model their land-value impact.

features.title: Infrastructure pipeline data layer
features.description: Track planned/funded/under-construction transit, roads, utilities, grid capacity, broadband/fiber, ports, and powered-land availability.

features.title: Infrastructure-impact + proximity uplift model
features.description: Model expected land-value uplift per parcel from nearby projects; value-capture analysis.

epics.name: AI Copilot and Agents
epics.goal: Provenance-grounded, human-supervised AI: a retrieval copilot, report generation, and autonomous agents.

features.title: Retrieval copilot platform (RAG over the land graph)
features.description: Natural-language Q&A grounded in the graph with mandatory citations; tool use; never invents parcels or unqualified numbers. Shared inference + guardrail layer reused by zoning AI and CV.

features.title: Automated market/parcel reports + memo generation
features.description: Generate policy-safe market reports, parcel memos, and IC decks from the graph.

features.title: Deal-sourcing + research agents
features.description: Multi-step agents that source deals to a thesis and automate diligence checklists.

features.title: Continuous-monitoring agents
features.description: Standing theses that run forever across countries, surfacing matches and anomalies with explanations.

features.title: Document / PDF extraction
features.description: Extract structured data from deeds, planning PDFs, and broker documents with citation back to the page.

epics.name: Marketplace and Transactions
epics.goal: Two-sided liquidity: verified listings, deal pipeline, transaction infrastructure, and the resulting data exhaust.

features.title: Verified listing marketplace
features.description: Bootstrap supply by giving brokers free tools in exchange for verified listings; discover + transact.
acceptance: supply seeded densely per launch market before expansion

features.title: Deal pipeline / CRM
features.description: Inquiry → pipeline CRM with annotations, notes, and audit trail (extends existing inquiries).

features.title: Transaction infrastructure + take-rate
features.description: Facilitate verified transactions with payments + take-rate accounting.

features.title: Marketplace data exhaust → graph
features.description: Feed marketplace activity (listings, closes) back into the canonical graph as proprietary comps/labels.

epics.name: Data licensing, API platform, and indices
epics.goal: Monetize the graph as a utility: bulk/metered API, licensing portal, indices, and embeds.

features.title: Public API platform + SDKs + developer portal
features.description: GA the versioned API with quotas, keys, docs, typed SDKs, and a self-serve developer portal.

features.title: Data licensing portal + clean rooms
features.description: Bulk data licensing with per-license scopes, entitlements, and partner clean-room arrangements.

features.title: Globe Land Indices
features.description: Benchmark/index products (the 'S&P for land') licensed to funds, derived reproducibly from canonical data.

features.title: Embeddable widgets + white-label
features.description: Embeddable Globe maps/widgets and white-label deployments with role-based access + data-residency controls.

epics.name: Platform scale (10M → 100M users)
epics.goal: Scale the architecture along read, write, and inference axes: lakehouse, multi-region, streaming, ML platform, agent infra, planetary graph.

features.title: Lakehouse + CDC analytics
features.description: S3 + Iceberg/Delta lakehouse fed by CDC from Postgres as the analytical truth; all derived indexes reproducible.
acceptance: every derived store rebuildable from canonical Postgres

features.title: Multi-region active-active + data residency
features.description: Region-partitioned, active-active deployment with per-jurisdiction data residency and sovereign isolated options.

features.title: Streaming backbone + processors
features.description: Kafka-class event mesh ingesting satellite/sensor/permit/market streams with stream processors for alerts + change detection.

features.title: ML platform: feature store + model registry + retraining
features.description: Shared feature store, model registry, scheduled retraining, and autoscaling inference for AVM/risk/CV/copilot.

features.title: Agent orchestration + eval/guardrail platform
features.description: Fleet orchestration for autonomous agents with safety evals and guardrails.

features.title: Planetary graph store + global H3 index
features.description: Graph DB + geospatial/H3 global index enabling planet-scale traversal and queries in seconds.
acceptance: global parcel graph queryable in seconds
